name: Remember That I Love You
summary: In the Ruins of Lordaeron, a stained letter calls for a missing child. Torn from parchment among the graves, it speaks of a child from the Heartweaver family. You carry it south to the orphanage in Stormwind City, hoping to learn what became of them.

sections.title: A Plea from the Ruins
sections.body: The ruined graveyard bears the marks of the Third War. Among grounds haunted by the undead, someone found a torn, blood-stained letter. It speaks of a missing child from the Heartweaver family. Prince Arthas and the Scourge swept through the kingdom and shattered their lives.

sections.title: Journey to the Orphanage
sections.body: Lordaeron fell, and the Undercity now fills the catacombs below. Refugees who escaped south scattered across the Alliance kingdoms. In Stormwind City, Orphan Matron Nightingale cares for children left without parents by the wars. You bring her the blood-stained letter, hoping she can identify a surviving Heartweaver child and give the family some closure.

faq.q: Where is the blood-stained letter found?
faq.answer: The torn, stained parchment was found in a graveyard in the Ruins of Lordaeron, where restless dead and Forsaken forces roam.
Little is known about the Heartweaver family. Their letter speaks of a missing child and raises hope that the child escaped south to an Alliance shelter.
Orphan Matron Nightingale oversees the Stormwind Orphanage in Cathedral Square. She gives food, shelter, and guidance to children orphaned by the recent wars.

faq.q: Why take a Lordaeron keepsake all the way to Stormwind?
faq.answer: When the Scourge overran Lordaeron, many orphaned children were evacuated south to the Kingdom of Stormwind. The parchment points you to the orphan matron in Stormwind City, who may know more.

faq.q: Can Horde players complete this quest?
faq.answer: The journey leads to Orphan Matron Nightingale in Stormwind City's Cathedral Square, placing it in Alliance hands.

faq.q: What state are the Ruins of Lordaeron in right now?
faq.answer: The surface ruins of Capital City are mostly deserted and crumbling, with lingering undead. Lady Sylvanas Windrunner and the Forsaken have fortified their underground capital, the Undercity, in the crypts below.

angles.text: For humans of Lordaeron lineage, this parchment recalls families torn apart when Capital City fell to Prince Arthas and the Scourge.
As an Alliance traveler, you carry the letter safely to Stormwind, honoring the northern families torn apart when Lordaeron fell.

attribution: In-game quest text: Remember That I Love You
